import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Survival Rate by Class and Sex
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF69B4', '#4169E1'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Class')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45)
ax1.legend(title='Sex')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution by Survival
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_age = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_age, survived_age], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#FF6B6B', '#51CF66'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival Rate by Embarkation Port
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
embark_survival['rate'] = embark_survival['sum'] / embark_survival['count']
embark_survival['rate'].plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#FF9999', '#66B2FF', '#99FF99'])
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax3.set_xticklabels(['S: Southampton', 'C: Cherbourg', 'Q: Queenstown'], rotation=45)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fare Distribution by Class
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
class_order = ['First', 'Second', 'Third']
df_clean = df[df['fare'] < 300]  # Remove outliers for better visualization
sns.boxplot(data=df_clean, x='class', y='fare', order=class_order, 
            palette='Set2', ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Class')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Family Size vs Survival
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
ax5.plot(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, marker='o', 
         linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#9B59B6')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size (including self)')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax5.set_xticks(range(1, 12))

# 6. Overall Survival Count
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
survival_counts = df['survived'].value_counts()
colors_pie = ['#FF6B6B', '#51CF66']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(survival_counts, labels=['Died', 'Survived'], 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie,
                                     startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 11})
ax6.set_title('Overall Survival Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

plt.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
